title: スマートファルコン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon and I begin our challenge of competing in the Twinkle Series at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her dream is to become a top Umadol—a new kind of idol who competes in races and shines brightly in concerts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The dirt races she's best suited for don't draw the same crowds as the ones on turf, but she's still determined to shine there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She puts on street performances daily, but a single little girl is her entire audience. However, her dream to become the top Umadol on dirt is only just beginning!
